decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - The use hereby permitted shall be discontinued and the sales office demolished, and the hoardings removed, with the site restored to its previous state prior to the construction of this sales office on or before 15th November 2008 in accordance with a scheme of work submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - The office floor space contained within this proposal hereby approved shall be used only as offices ancillary to the marketing and sales of properties situated on the Heston Park site and shall not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 4 - A Part M compliant access ramp shall be fixed to the front access of the port-a-cabin and suitable arrangements for an unhindered level path from the parking courtyard of approved development 00798/D/P7 to the access ramp of minimum width 0.80m shall be implemented before the port-a-cabin is occupied, and shall remain as such for the full duration of the marketing suite.
Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted for marketing and sales purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times 8am to 9pm, Monday to Sunday.
description: Erection of a temporary building for use as a maketing suite.
